name: FND_SEARCH_OPTIONS_B
description: The primary table storing Fusion Search Options.  These options are passed to Oracle Fusion Search (Global Search) at runtime.

columns.name: ENTERPRISE_ID
columns.description: ENTERPRISE_ID

columns.name: SEARCH_OPTION_ID
columns.description: SEARCH_OPTION_ID - Unique internal id for primary key.

columns.name: SEARCH_OPTION_CODE
columns.description: SEARCH_OPTION_CODE - A unique code passed to Global Search task flows.

columns.name: PILLAR
columns.description: PILLAR - Where the Options will be used.

columns.name: MODULE_ID
columns.description: Seed Data Framework: indicates the module that owns the row. A module is an entry in Application Taxonomy such as a Logical Business Area. When the MODULE_ID column exists and the owner of the row is not specified, then the Seed Data Framework will not extract the row as seed data.

columns.name: OPTION_ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: OPTION_ENABLED_FLAG - Is this option enabled (Y/N).

columns.name: DEFAULT_OPTION_FLAG
columns.description: DEFAULT_OPTION_FLAG - Is this option the default (Y/N).  Only one option can be the default.

columns.name: SEARCH_FIELD_CAT_ENA_FLAG
columns.description: SEARCH_FIELD_CAT_ENA_FLAG - Does the user see the search categories customization UI with the search field.  This does not effect the filtering in the search results UI.

columns.name: SEARCH_FIELD_GRPS_ENA_FLAG
columns.description: SEARCH_FIELD_GRPS_ENA_FLAG - Does the user see the suggest groups customization UI with the search field.

columns.name: SEARCH_FIELD_MAX_LEN
columns.description: SEARCH_FIELD_MAX_LEN - The maximum number of characters the search field can take.

columns.name: SEARCH_FIELD_MIN_LEN
columns.description: SEARCH_FIELD_MIN_LEN - The minimum number of characters required in the search field for searching.

columns.name: SEARCH_FIELD_CLR_ON_SEARCH
columns.description: SEARCH_FIELD_CLR_ON_SEARCH - Is the search field value cleared after a search is performed, allowing clean input for the user next time.

columns.name: SEARCH_FIELD_SF_ENA_FLAG
columns.description: SEARCH_FIELD_SF_ENA_FLAG - Is the 'Search for' link enabled (Y/N).

columns.name: SUGGEST_ONLY_FLAG
columns.description: SUGGEST_ONLY_FLAG - Does the search field only do suggestions (Y/N)?  If 'Y', no Search Engine results are shown and it is assumed that autosuggest is sufficient for search needs.

columns.name: SEARCH_CATEGORY_APP_STRIPE
columns.description: SEARCH_CATEGORY_APP_STRIPE - an allplication stripe to use if all categories for an application stripe are to be used.

columns.name: SEARCH_CATEGORIES
columns.description: SEARCH_CATEGORIES - A CSV list of appid:CAT_NAME

columns.name: SAVED_SEARCHES_ENA_FLAG
columns.description: SAVED_SEARCHES_ENA_FLAG - Are saved searches enabled?

columns.name: RECENT_SEARCHES_ENA_FLAG
columns.description: RECENT_SEARCHES_ENA_FLAG - Are recent searches enabled?

columns.name: APPLIED_FILTERS_ENA_FLAG
columns.description: APPLIED_FILTERS_ENA_FLAG - Are the applied filters shown in the results UI?

columns.name: FILTER_SUBCAT_ENA_FLAG
columns.description: FILTER_SUBCAT_ENA_FLAG - Are the subcategory filters shown in the Filters area of the search result?

columns.name: FILTER_FACETS_ENA_FLAG
columns.description: FILTER_FACETS_ENA_FLAG- Are the facet filters shown in the Filters area of the search result?  Subcategories must be enabled for this to be relevant as facets are a child object of subcategories.

columns.name: FILTER_FACET_CNT_ENA_FLAG
columns.description: FILTER_FACET_CNT_ENA_FLAG - Are the facet counts shown in the Filters area of the search result?  Facets must be enabled for this to be relevant.

columns.name: FILTER_CLEAR_ALL_ENA_FLAG
columns.description: FILTER_CLEAR_ALL_ENA_FLAG - Is the clear all filters button shown in the Filters area of the search result?

columns.name: FILTER_LOV_STYLE
columns.description: FILTER_LOV_STYLE - The style of filters used, either 'lov' or 'inline'.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE_FILTER
columns.description: LAST_UPDATE_DATE_FILTER - a CSV list of last update date filters to be shown to the user.  If this is null, all values are shown.

columns.name: RESULT_ICONS_ENA
columns.description: RESULT_ICONS_ENA- Are icons shown in the results UI when available? Vald values 'on' and 'off'.

columns.name: SUGGEST_GROUPS
columns.description: SUGGEST_GROUPS - a csv list of suggest groups.

columns.name: SUGGEST_TOP_SUGGESTIONS_ENA
columns.description: SUGGEST_TOP_SUGGESTIONS_ENA - Are top suggestions on or off?  Top suggestions are those suggestions shown before there have been enough characters typed for meaningful suggestions based on the typed values to be shown.

columns.name: SUGGEST_GRP_HEADINGS_ENA
columns.description: SUGGEST_GRP_HEADINGS_ENA - Are the Suggest group headings shown - valid values 'on' and 'off'.

columns.name: SUGGEST_GRP_ICONS_ENA
columns.description: SUGGEST_GRP_ICONS_ENA - Are the Suggest group heading icons shown - valid values 'on' and 'off'.

columns.name: SUGGEST_MIN_CHARS_FOR_SUG
columns.description: SUGGEST_MIN_CHARS_FOR_SUG - The minimum number of characters before search suggest takes over from top suggestions.

columns.name: SUGGEST_MAX_SUGGESTIONS
columns.description: SUGGEST_MAX_SUGGESTIONS - The maximum total number of suggestions across all groups.  This value applied for top suggestions and regular per-key autosuggest.

columns.name: SUGGEST_SYN_ENA_FLAG
columns.description: SUGGEST_SYN_ENA_FLAG - Are synonyms enabled for autosuggest in the search field?

columns.name: SUGGEST_SYN_CONTEXT_CODE
columns.description: SUGGEST_SYN_CONTEXT_CODE - Optional code for supplying contextural striping for synonyms.

columns.name: SUGGEST_SYN_OBJECT_TYPE
columns.description: SUGGEST_SYN_OBJECT_TYPE - a sub classification of CONTEXT_CODE for contextural striping for synonyms.

columns.name: SEARCH_FACTORY_EXPRESSION
columns.description: SEARCH_FACTORY_EXPRESSION - Either a fully qualified class name of an AbstractSearchableFactory an EL expression that creates an AbstractSearchableFactory or null for the default ECSF Factory.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Seed data file from which the row originates.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
